brief.business_idea: An open-source AI co-founder that helps entrepreneurs investigate digital startup ideas and design validation experiments
brief.target_customer: Entrepreneurs investigating an early-stage digital product idea
brief.core_problem: Founders may struggle to distinguish supported claims from assumptions and choose a practical next validation experiment
main_assumptions: Entrepreneurs have recently struggled to turn an uncertain startup assumption into a concrete validation experiment
founder_constraints: No paid AI services or payments
Local artifacts only; founder approval before artifact generation

landing_page.headline: Put your startup assumptions to the test.
landing_page.value_proposition: Explore an AI co-founder concept that helps turn uncertain digital-product ideas into practical validation experiments.
landing_page.target_audience: Entrepreneurs exploring an early-stage digital product
landing_page.problem: An idea can sound convincing while its central assumptions still need evidence.
landing_page.proposed_solution: Investigate the idea, challenge unsupported assumptions, and prepare an experiment for founder review.
features: Structured hypotheses and customer-discovery interview guides
Explicit proposed success criteria and evidence that could weaken a hypothesis
Local concept pages with founder approval before generation
